name: DriverProfile
description: Durable driver record — onboarded once at the door, issued a QR code, scanned on every subsequent visit. Tracks YTD payout for 1099 reporting. Distinct from DriverPayout (which is a per-night disbursement ledger entry).

venue_id.description: Venue scope. Driver profiles are per-venue.

affiliated.description: True = NUPS-owned/contracted driver. False = outside driver. Controls payout rate leg in VenueRateConfig.

qr_code.description: Stable QR token printed on driver's card. Scanned at the door for instant load — no paper, no re-entry.

qr_token.description: DACO-20260613-MOBILE-SCANNER — Server-signed HMAC payload for QR generation. Format: {driver_id}|{venue_id}|{issued_at}|{signature}. Signature recomputed server-side on verify.

qr_signature.description: DACO-20260613-MOBILE-SCANNER — HMAC-SHA256 signature of qr_token, computed server-side with per-venue key. Never exposed to client.

qr_issued_at.description: DACO-20260613-MOBILE-SCANNER — Timestamp when QR was signed. Used to detect replay attacks and stale tokens.

ytd_payout_total.description: Year-to-date payout total. Incremented atomically on every DriverPayout posting.

ytd_year.description: Calendar year for current ytd_payout_total. Reset January 1.

ten99_flag.description: True when ytd_payout_total crosses 1099 reporting threshold ($600 IRS default; configurable per jurisdiction).

onboarded_by.description: Email of staff who onboarded the driver.
